overview.purpose_zh: 这张散点图把每个广告活动放在两个效率指标上：横轴是获客成本，纵轴是广告回报。一个点就是一个活动，点整体排成的方向说明两个指标怎么一起变。
works_zh: 适合看两个数值指标是同向变化还是反向变化。
适合发现大多数点集中在哪一段，以及谁单独落在外面。
适合在调整预算前先看整体格局，而不是只盯一个活动。
uses_zh: 营销周会上的投放复盘。
向管理层解释为什么不能只看单个活动。
判断哪些活动值得单独拿出来讨论。

understanding.read_zh: 先看整团点往哪个方向斜：从左上到右下是负相关，从左下到右上正相关。再看点的疏密：大多数点挤在哪一段，有没有一两个点离得很远。最后看同一横坐标上有没有高低不同的点，那说明横轴这个指标一个人决定不了纵轴。

elements.note_zh: 获客成本，获取一个客户平均花掉多少钱，越往右越贵。
广告回报，数字越高说明同样的花费带回的收入越多。
一个点就是一个广告活动，点的位置由两个数值共同决定。
标出活动名称，方便把异常的点叫出名字。

look_for_zh: 点整体是向上、向下还是散成一团。
大多数点集中在哪一段成本上。
有没有单独落在远处的点。

observations.en: The points slope downward: the two campaigns at a CPA of 10 sit highest, with ROAS of 680 and 740, while the campaign at 40 sits at 250.
observations.zh: 点整体向下倾斜：获客成本 10 的两个活动位置最高，回报分别是 680 和 740，而成本 40 的那个只有 250。

observations.en: Most campaigns cluster between a CPA of 10 and 25; only two sit above that band, at 33 and 40.
observations.zh: 多数活动集中在获客成本 10 到 25 之间；高于这个区间的只有两个，分别在 33 和 40。

observations.en: CPA alone does not settle the outcome: two campaigns both sit at 20, but their ROAS is 310 and 360.
observations.zh: 单看获客成本决定不了结果：两个活动的成本都是 20，回报却分别是 310 和 360。

observations.en: Influencer kit is a clear outlier on cost, at a CPA of 40, and it also has the lowest ROAS, 250.
observations.zh: Influencer kit 在成本上是明显的离群点，获客成本 40，回报也是最低的 250。

observations.en: The chart shows association, not cause: the lower returns at higher cost may come from other differences between the campaigns.
observations.zh: 这张图显示的是关联，不是因果：高成本伴随的低回报，可能来自活动之间的其他差别。

describe.en: Cost per acquisition and ROAS show a negative correlation: the two campaigns at a CPA of 10 return 680 and 740, while the campaign at 40 returns 250.
describe.zh: 获客成本和广告回报呈负相关：获客成本 10 的两个活动回报是 680 和 740，获客成本 40 的活动只有 250。
describe.pattern: a negative correlation between A and B
alternatives: The scatter shows a downward relationship between CPA and ROAS.
As CPA rises, ROAS tends to fall in this data.
describe.note_zh: 说负相关要同时点名两个变量，再各给一个端点值，方向才站得住。

describe.en: Most campaigns cluster around a CPA of 10 to 25, where ROAS ranges from 280 to 740.
describe.zh: 多数活动集中在 10 到 25 的获客成本区间，对应的回报从 280 到 740。
alternatives: The points bunch between a CPA of 10 and 25.
Only two campaigns fall outside the main cluster.
describe.note_zh: 先给集中的区间，再补区间里的数值范围，读者马上知道主体在哪。

describe.en: Email winback's ROAS of 740 is higher than Brand search's 680, even though both sit at the same CPA of 10.
describe.zh: Email winback 的回报 740 高于 Brand search 的 680，尽管两者的获客成本都是 10。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure
alternatives: At the same CPA, one campaign returns 740 and the other 680.
Brand search returns 680 against Email winback's 740.
describe.note_zh: 两者横坐标相同时比较纵坐标，能看出成本之外的差别。

describe.en: Influencer kit is a clear outlier on the cost axis: at a CPA of 40 it stands alone to the right of every other campaign.
describe.zh: Influencer kit 在成本轴上是明显的离群点：获客成本 40，孤零零地站在所有其他活动的右边。
describe.pattern: an outlier in + group / a clear outlier
alternatives: Only one campaign goes beyond a CPA of 33.
The point at 40 sits well away from the rest.
describe.note_zh: 离群点不一定是错误，先把它的名称和两个数值读出来，再决定要不要单独讨论。

describe.en: A higher CPA is associated with a lower ROAS here, but the chart alone cannot show that the extra cost causes the lower return.
describe.zh: 在这里，获客成本越高，回报越低；但只看这张图，不能说明多花的成本导致了更低的回报。
alternatives: Higher cost and lower return appear together in this data.
The chart shows an association, not a cause.
describe.note_zh: associated with 只讲一起出现，不讲原因；要下因果结论需要实验或更多证据。

describe.en: The pattern is a correlation, not proof of cause: the two campaigns at a CPA of 10 differ in ROAS by 60.
describe.zh: 这是一个相关关系，不是因果证据：同样获客成本为 10 的两个活动，回报相差 60。
describe.pattern: correlation does not imply causation / correlation is not causation
alternatives: Correlation is not causation, even when the pattern looks tidy.
The scatter cannot rule out other explanations.
describe.note_zh: 这句话用来给结论踩刹车，放在因果判断之前最自然。

academic.en: The scatter plot compares cost per acquisition with return on ad spend for eight campaigns. The points form a broadly downward pattern. The two campaigns at a CPA of 10 return 680 and 740; the campaigns at 20 return 310 and 360; the single campaign at 40 returns 250. Most points lie between a CPA of 10 and 25, and the two above that band sit at 33 and 40. The vertical spread at a CPA of 20 indicates that cost alone does not determine return. The chart supports a statement of negative association, not a claim about cause.
academic.zh: 这张散点图比较八个广告活动的获客成本和广告回报。点整体呈向下的趋势。获客成本 10 的两个活动回报为 680 和 740；成本 20 的两个活动回报为 310 和 360；成本 40 的那个活动回报为 250。多数点落在成本 10 到 25 之间，高于这个区间的两个点分别在 33 和 40。同为成本 20 的两个点高低不同，说明单看成本决定不了回报。这张图支持「负相关」的说法，不能支持因果结论。

business.en: Cheap acquisition is where the return is. The two campaigns at a CPA of 10 deliver ROAS of 680 and 740, the best on the chart, while the campaign at 40 delivers 250. Anything above a CPA of 25 deserves a closer look: the two campaigns there return 300 and 250. Do not read this as proof that cutting CPA lifts ROAS. Use it to choose which campaigns to test with a small budget change, then measure what happens.
business.zh: 便宜拿到用户的地方回报最好。获客成本 10 的两个活动回报是 680 和 740，是图里最高的；成本 40 的那个只有 250。成本超过 25 的两个活动值得单独看：回报分别是 300 和 250。不要把这张图当成「压低保获客成本就能提高回报」的证据。它的用处是挑出先做小额测试的活动，再回头看结果。

simple.en: Each dot is one ad campaign. The dot on the left pays 10 to get one customer and earns back 740. The dot on the right pays 40 and earns back 250. Most dots sit between 10 and 25. When the cost is higher, the return is usually lower. That is a pattern, not proof of cause.
simple.zh: 每个点是一个广告活动。左边的点每拿到一个客户花 10，回报是 740。右边的点花 40，回报只有 250。大多数点落在 10 到 25 之间。成本越高，回报通常越低。这是一个规律，不是因果证据。

language_notes.title_en: Name both axes and their units
language_notes.body_zh: 散点图的句子要交代两个轴分别是什么、单位是什么。CPA 是获取一个客户花掉的钱，写成 a CPA of $10；ROAS 是回报率，写成 a ROAS of 740%。两个数放在一起，读者才知道点在哪个位置。
examples: The campaign sits at a CPA of $10 with a ROAS of 740%.

language_notes.body_zh: 散点图能说明两个指标一起怎么变，不能说明谁导致谁。写结论用 be associated with、tend to，别用 cause、lead to。预算、受众、素材都在同时变化，一张图分不出是哪一个在起作用。
examples: A higher CPA is associated with a lower ROAS here.
The chart does not prove that cost causes the difference in return.

language_notes.title_en: At a CPA of 20 vs at 20
language_notes.body_zh: 第一次提到一个指标时，带上它的名称和单位：at a CPA of $20。后面同一段里再提，可以缩成 at $20 或 at that cost。不要从头到尾只写 at 20，读者会忘了这是成本还是回报。
examples: Two campaigns sit at a CPA of $20.
